class.name: ResourceTextSerializer
class.brief_description: Converts any [Resource] to JSON, INI, CSV, XML or TOML text and back, based on its stored properties.

method.name: can_serialize
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param resource] can be written in [param format]: the format is available (see [method is_format_available]) and, for [constant FORMAT_CSV], the resource fits CSV: exactly one typed array of resources, elements of that type with only simple properties, and no other property that differs from its default value.

method.name: deserialize
dictionary_to_resource
method.description: Creates a resource from [param data], a [Dictionary] in the layout of [method resource_to_dictionary]. If [param data] has no [code]"$type"[/code] key, [param type_hint] gives the class. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if no resource can be created.

method.name: get_available_formats
method.description: Returns the [enum Format] values that [method serialize] and [method deserialize] can use in this build, in ascending order: [constant FORMAT_JSON], [constant FORMAT_INI], [constant FORMAT_CSV] and [constant FORMAT_XML] from the engine core, and [constant FORMAT_TOML] if the TOML module is part of the build.

method.name: get_format_extension
method.description: Returns the file extension of [param format] without a dot ([code]"json"[/code], [code]"ini"[/code], [code]"csv"[/code], [code]"xml"[/code], [code]"toml"[/code], [code]"yaml"[/code]), or an empty string for [constant FORMAT_MAX].

method.name: get_format_from_extension
method.description: Returns the format of the file extension [param extension], or [constant FORMAT_MAX] if no format has it. Case and a leading dot are ignored, so [code]".JSON"[/code] gives [constant FORMAT_JSON]; [code]"yml"[/code] gives [constant FORMAT_YAML]. Use it with [method String.get_extension] to pick the format of a file path.

method.name: is_format_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param format] has an implementation in this build. [constant FORMAT_TOML] needs the TOML module, [constant FORMAT_YAML] the YAML module.

method.name: resource_to_dictionary
method.description: Returns [param resource] as a [Dictionary] that contains only JSON types ([Dictionary], [Array], [String], numbers, booleans and [code]null[/code]): the same layout as the JSON format. Of [param options], [member SerializerOptions.enums_as_names], [member SerializerOptions.defaults], [member SerializerOptions.include_type_marker], [member SerializerOptions.sort_keys] and [member SerializerOptions.full_precision_floats] apply; [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. This is the tree that custom text formats build on.

method.name: serialize

constants.constant: CSV: one row per element of a list resource.
XML: one element per resource and per property.
TOML: implemented by the TOML module. Not available if the module is disabled (see [method is_format_available]).
YAML: implemented by the YAML module. Not available if the module is disabled (see [method is_format_available]).
Represents the size of the [enum Format] enum. Also returned by [method get_format_from_extension] for an unknown extension.

Version of the text layout. It is written as [code]"$format_version"[/code] into JSON and TOML files, into the INI section [code][root][/code] and as the attribute [code]format_version[/code] of the XML root element. A file with a higher version is read with a warning.
